outlook.statement: Company remains optimistic about growth prospects with strong strategic focus on technical textile segment, particularly personal protective wear, supported by heightened global emphasis on workplace safety standards and rising institutional demand across domestic and export markets.

Company is actively enhancing production capacity in processing & garmenting division to meet increasing demand; addressing shortage of skilled tailors through targeted recruitment drives and structured skill development programs.
Company confident of executing successful turnaround in upcoming fiscal year by focusing on high-margin segments, maintaining operational rigor, and investing in workforce capabilities.
Global technical textiles market valued at approximately $252.8 billion, projected to surge to $329.2 billion by 2030 at CAGR of 5.6%; Indian Protech sector expanding at estimated CAGR of 12% to 14%.
Outlook for Global Technical Textile trade remains cautiously optimistic; stabilization of freight routes and normalization of inventory cycles could further support industry's path to recovery.
Considering the progress achieved so far in operational improvement and liquidity enhancement, the management is restructuring & consolidation of operations during the year.

Key factors that may impact performance include market demand, raw material availability and pricing, changes in government policies, regulatory developments, tax laws, economic conditions, and other operational or legal matters.

Management continues its efforts in rationalizing its operations by further prioritizing high-value contribution segments and embark on steps towards cost optimization to achieve the targeted operational profitability and sustainability.

The Company continues its efforts towards realignment and rationalisation of its manufacturing operations with the objective of improving capacity utilisation, enhancing operational efficiencies and optimising costs to achieve sustainable profitability at the operational level. During the year, the Company has made considerable progress in monetisation of underutilised and non-core assets and has further identified certain assets for monetisation, including assets classified as 'Held for Sale', with the objective of reduction of debt, strengthening liquidity and improving overall cost efficiencies. Considering the progress achieved so far in operational improvement and liquidity enhancement, the management is confident of achieving sustainable operational profitability in the near future.
